notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vorel.
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
4 charge counters on Gemstone Array.
description:
Pay {U}{G} and tap Vorel, doubling the number of charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Remove 3 charge counters from Gemstone Array to add {U}{U}{G}.
Pay {U} to untap Vorel.
Repeat.
